app-templates.message:
fix(explainer): the e2e counts the formulas in the texts of a quiz question

## Intent

Since #46, the runtime renders formulas in the question, options, background and explanation of quiz questions, some of them twice. The outline, which the end-to-end tests compare a page's <math> elements with, did not count them, so an explainer with such a formula failed lernapps check (#47).

## Key changes

- The outline counts the <math> elements the renderer writes for a question exercise, as it already does for the worked tasks of a generated one.
- The all-blocks fixture has formulas in a question's explanation and in an option's background.
- A unit test compares the outline with the rendered page for every content page of that fixture.

## Dependencies and side effects

- tooling pins this fix (772bbdc).

Closes #47

fix(explainer): pin app-templates at 5df0763, which counts formulas in quiz texts

## Intent

An explainer with a formula in the text of a quiz question failed lernapps check, which blocked updating lernapps/elektrizitaet. Apps get the fix through the pin.

## Key changes

- app-templates is pinned at 5df0763 (app-templates#51, closes app-templates#47): the end-to-end test "one <math> per formula" counts the formulas the runtime renders in the question, options, background and explanation of quiz questions.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Needs the fix in app-templates (26c8210).
